import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a bar chart for the top 5 most popular products
top_products = coffee_sales['product'].value_counts().head(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_products.index, y=top_products.values)
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Top 5 Most Popular Products')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

payment_methods = coffee_sales['payment_method'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))
plt.pie(payment_methods.values, labels=payment_methods.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Payment Methods')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
